title: What UT has put into its tuition promise
subtitle: Endowments and additions approved by the University of Texas System since 2019
alt: Bar chart of money the University of Texas System has committed to its Promise Plus tuition program: a $167 million endowment in 2019, a second endowment of $300 million in 2022, an added $35 million in 2025, and an additional $65 million approved for 2027
source: UT System figures, via The Daily Texan
